description: An association between a Disease and a Gene, supported by one or more sources. Evidence can represent curated gene–phenotype relationships with known molecular basis, DISEASES knowledge, experimental or text-mining support, genome-wide-significant variant associations assigned to genes, or HPO phenotype–gene annotations. The source contributions distinguish these different meanings and scopes.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Sources supporting the Disease–Gene association. Source values are DISEASES, omim, GWAS_catalog and HPO.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of creation or a change to the association’s evidence or source support.

source_contributions.scope: Human associations in the knowledge, experiments and textmining channels with standardized confidence ≥ 3.0. Only Disease Ontology-identified records represented by existing Disease and Gene nodes are included; non-DOID and unresolved records are excluded.
source_contributions.description: Jensen Lab DISEASES supplies protein/gene–disease evidence from curated knowledge, experiments and text mining. Multiple qualifying rows, including different sub-sources in the same channel, remain separate evidence entries. Raw scores have different meanings across channels; the standardized confidence is the shared inclusion measure.

properties.name: diseases_sources
properties.description: Evidence channel for each supporting DISEASES row: knowledge, experiments or textmining.
properties.notes: The four `diseases_*` lists are parallel: entry *i* in each list describes the same source row.

properties.name: diseases_scores
properties.description: Channel-specific raw scores: CURATED for knowledge, the raw score text for experiments, and the z-score for textmining.
properties.notes: The four `diseases_*` lists are parallel: entry *i* in each list describes the same source row.

properties.name: diseases_confidences
properties.description: Standardized Jensen Lab confidence on a 0–5 scale. Included evidence has confidence at least 3.0.
properties.notes: The four `diseases_*` lists are parallel: entry *i* in each list describes the same source row.

properties.name: diseases_identifiers
properties.description: Sub-source name for knowledge and experiments, or an evidence-page URL for textmining.
properties.notes: The four `diseases_*` lists are parallel: entry *i* in each list describes the same source row.

source_contributions.scope: Human OMIM genemap2 gene–phenotype entries with mapping key 3: molecular basis known and causative mutation identified. Both endpoints must be represented in SPOKE. Where an OMIM phenotype corresponds to several Disease concepts, associations include every matching concept, including broader and narrower concepts.
source_contributions.description: Curated gene–phenotype associations with known molecular basis. Distinct inheritance modes from all qualifying entries for the same Disease–Gene pair are represented together.

properties.name: inheritance
properties.description: Distinct inheritance modes across qualifying OMIM phenotype entries for this Disease–Gene pair.
properties.notes: Empty list `[]` if no contributing entry supplies an inheritance mode

source_contributions.scope: Published GWAS Catalog associations with p ≤ 5×10⁻⁸, restricted to traits represented by Disease Ontology terms through EFO and to genes represented in SPOKE. Traits with no supported Disease representation are excluded; rows combining a disease and a non-disease trait can be included. Gene endpoints are genes containing the variant or the nearest gene on each side for intergenic variants; no flanking-gene distance cutoff is applied.
source_contributions.description: GWAS evidence retains the authors’ trait wording, curated traits, study, publication, variant, association statistics and gene position. Author-reported genes are evidence rather than the endpoint assignment. Multiple supporting entries can describe the same Disease–Gene pair; exact duplicate source rows are collapsed. A source row may support several Disease or Gene endpoints.

properties.name: gwas_reported_traits
properties.description: Authors’ descriptive disease or trait wording.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Always present in kept rows; if empty, `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_mapped_traits
properties.description: Curated mapped trait labels, retaining the full source cell, which may contain several labels.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Always present in kept rows; if empty, `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_reported_genes
properties.description: Genes attributed to the signal by the study authors, as free text. These names do not determine the Gene endpoint.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Empty cell, `"NR"` and `"intergenic"` (matched case-insensitively, e.g. `"Intergenic"`) → `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_gene_positions
properties.description: Whether the variant is in the endpoint gene, or the endpoint is its upstream or downstream flanking gene.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Always one of `"in_gene"`, `"upstream"`, `"downstream"`

properties.name: gwas_intergenic
properties.description: Whether the variant is between genes.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. `INTERGENIC` (`1` → true, `0` → false)

properties.name: gwas_gene_distances
properties.description: Variant-to-gene distance for the corresponding upstream or downstream gene.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. `"in_gene"` entries → `0`. Flanking entry with missing/unparseable distance → `NaN`

properties.name: gwas_studies
properties.description: GWAS Catalog study accession, such as GCST003176.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Always present; if empty, `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_pubmed_ids
properties.description: PubMed identifier of the publication, stored as a bare number string.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Always present; if empty, `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_snps
properties.description: Variant and risk allele as reported, including haplotype or interaction strings when present.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Always present; if empty, `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_p_values
properties.description: Association p-value; included evidence satisfies p ≤ 5×10⁻⁸. Extremely small values may be stored as 0.0 or a subnormal value.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Always present in kept rows (filter requires a parseable value). Values below double range are stored as converted (0.0 or subnormal)

properties.name: gwas_effect_sizes
properties.description: Odds ratio or beta coefficient from the mixed effect-size column. Source beta values are unsigned; direction and units are in the confidence-interval text.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Empty/unparseable → `NaN`

properties.name: gwas_effect_ci
properties.description: Confidence-interval text as reported; for beta coefficients this also carries direction and unit.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Empty → `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_effect_types
properties.description: Effect-size interpretation: beta when confidence-interval text contains increase or decrease, otherwise OR when an effect value is present, otherwise NA. OR is an accepted assumption when a value has no confidence-interval text.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. `"beta"` if the CI text contains "increase" or "decrease" (case-insensitive); else `"OR"` if an effect value is present; else `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_variant_contexts
properties.description: Reported variant functional context, such as intron_variant.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Empty → `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_risk_allele_freqs
properties.description: Risk allele frequency when the source value is a plain number.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Empty, `"NR"`, or any value that does not parse as a plain number (e.g. `"0.67 (EA)"`, `"0.21-0.27"`) → `NaN`

properties.name: gwas_sample_sizes
properties.description: Discovery sample description as reported in INITIAL SAMPLE SIZE.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Empty → `"NA"`

properties.name: gwas_ancestry_notes
properties.description: Free-text p-value qualifier, often an ancestry note.
properties.notes: All `gwas_*` properties are lists of equal length. Entry *i* of every `gwas_*` list describes the same supporting entry. Empty → `"NA"`

source_contributions.scope: HPO phenotype-to-genes annotations whose Gene and HPO-enriched Symptom are represented in SPOKE, and whose phenotype concept is also represented as a Disease through the Symptom’s MeSH identifier. Every corresponding Disease is included, including broader, narrower and parallel concepts.
source_contributions.description: Associations to the phenotype concept in HPO annotations. The Disease endpoint represents that phenotype, rather than the disorder listed in the original annotation. Different source disorders can support the same phenotype–gene association. HPO supplies no additional confidence, inheritance or quantitative evidence properties.
